ipabet:modifier.meaning: pull toward the center — the ə-neighborhood (e⇧5→ɜ, o⇧5→ɞ, a⇧5→ɐ); ə itself is the 5 base's default, 5⇧H
the h-digraph — plosives spirantize (tH→θ, pH→ɸ), sibilants hush (sH→ʃ), vowels lax (iH→ɪ, uH→ʊ); for a, back (aH→ɑ)
central — the y-vowels (iY→ɨ, uY→ʉ, eY→ɘ, oY→ɵ, aY→ä); Welsh y, Russian ы
click — base letter is the anterior place (p bilabial, t dental, q alveolar, c palatal, l lateral)

ipabet:term.note: Vocabulary for the flags on each mark. Membership lives on the mark, not here.
Absent or true: on the official IPA chart. false: not, and `beyond` names the tradition.
Not IPA. Carried so the layout can write real orthographies and romanizations.
Standard within a phonological tradition but absent from the IPA chart.
Extensions to the IPA, for disordered speech (the 2015 chart).
The key claims the mark by neither phonetics, shape, nor convention.
What ⌥⇧ means for a mark that has a `double`. Six senses; orthogonal to `exclusive`.
⌥⇧ is the greater pole of one dimension: advanced, raised, more rounded, ATR, upstep.
⌥⇧ is the more extreme value on a scale: extra-high, extra-low.
⌥⇧ is the diminished value: secondary stress, half-long.
⌥⇧ is a different diacritic sharing this shape, sitting below the base.
The two forms are independent — a shape or kin relation, no polarity. They stack.
An unpolarized dual: one dimension, neither value greater.
⌥⇧ is the same mark on the other side of the base.
The two forms are values of one dimension, so ⌥⇧ replaces rather than stacks.

COMBINING TILDE (nasalized; press again: ͊ denasal → ͋ nasal escape → ͌ velopharyngeal friction — the nasal-port dimension)
COMBINING BREVE (extra-short; ⇧ → ̮ breve below — DIN Arabic ḫ)
COMBINING CEDILLA (⇧ → ̡ palatalized hook — the cedilla's sibling curl; the palatal hook on the palatal letter, Slavicist t̡ d̡)
COMBINING OGONEK (the Polish nasal hook; ⇧ → ̐ candrabindu, Indic nasalization — the nasal tenants on the nasal letter)
COMBINING SHORT STROKE OVERLAY (⇧ → ̴ tilde overlay, velarized-or-pharyngealized; ¥ — y is the world's best-known stroked letter — is a memory hook, not a claim)
COMBINING LEFT HALF RING BELOW (less rounded; press again: ͍ labial spreading — the un-rounding ladder. ⇧ → ̹ more rounded; press again: ͎ whistled — rounding taken to its endpoint)
COMBINING LEFT ANGLE BELOW (weak articulation; ⇧ → ͈ strong/fortis, the Korean tense mark — F for force)
COMBINING SEAGULL BELOW (linguolabial — tongue to lips; ⇧ → ‖ the major intonation-group double bar, its single-bar partner | the native ⇧\ key)
MODIFIER LETTER TURNED COMMA (ʻokina — Hawaiian, Uzbek oʻ; ⇧ → ʼ ejective. Opening form unshifted, as on every quote key)
DOWNWARDS ARROW (ingressive airflow, extIPA; ⇧ → ↑ egressive — the digits' arrow run: step 6, contour 7, airflow 8)
MODIFIER LETTER HIGH TONE BAR (⇧ → ͇ alveolar, extIPA — the alveolar mark on the alveolar-tap digit)
COMBINING LEFT ANGLE ABOVE (no audible release; ⇧ → ͢ the sliding-articulation tie, extIPA)
COMBINING DOT ABOVE (pressed again on its own pending dot it commits · — the interpunct, Catalan's punt volat: l ⌥. ⌥. l → l·l)
MODIFIER LETTER PRIME (Cyrillic romanization's soft sign — Gorʹkij; ⇧ → ʺ double prime, the hard sign)
MATHEMATICAL LEFT ANGLE BRACKET (the grapheme brackets — /phoneme/ [phone] ⟨grapheme⟩; opening unshifted, per the quote law. « » are the French locale's primary quotes)
COMBINING INVERTED BREVE BELOW (non-syllabic — the diphthong glide, a vowel mark on the vowel key; ⇧ → ̑ the Slavic long-falling accent)

ipabet:prose.optShiftAbout: Deliberate ⌥⇧<digit> spends. There is no raw-US digit escape; an unlisted ⌥⇧<digit> passes to the host.
ipabet:prose.quotesAbout: ⌥[ opens primary, ⌥⇧[ closes it; ⌥] / ⌥⇧] are the secondary pair. `default` names a key of `locales`.
ipabet:prose.supRule: Generated from Unicode: a glyph raises iff a character exists whose compatibility decomposition is <super> of it. Raised letters Unicode gives no decomposition are added by hand — ʔ→ˀ, ʕ→ˤ, Ƀ→ᴯ, ᴎ→ᴻ, ᴉ→ᵎ, ꜳ→𐞀 — so the table is the complete set.
ipabet:prose.subRule: Generated from Unicode: a glyph lowers iff a character exists whose compatibility decomposition is <sub> of it. Nothing lacks one.
